purpose: Public development pilot: distinguish direct combination search from workflow execution with an explicit exact solver. Not a model ranking or population difficulty study.

solver_assistance.inputs: Current revealed catalogue, uncovered public goals and remaining work only
solver_assistance.effect: Returns a revision-tagged plan or explicit no-plan/search-limit result. Never probes, builds or verifies.
solver_assistance.cost: One step and one solver call; zero operational points. Search states reported separately; conditions do not match total compute.

primary_description: Report all four acceptance outcomes, actions, work, solver calls/states, elapsed time, request failures and usage availability. Report within-model solver_assisted-minus-open descriptively; one seed gives no uncertainty interval.
order: Existing collector order: open Sol, open GLM, solver_assisted Sol, solver_assisted GLM. No randomization; serving/time drift is not controlled.
stopping_rule: Exactly four episodes, one attempt each; no additional seeds, retries, replacement attempts or setting changes after preparation. Publish plan and source before requests.
failure_policy: Retain task, schema, transport, search-limit and deadline failures. Unknown usage stays unknown. Censored open results cannot establish a cognitive boundary or a causal solver rescue.
interpretation: A fixed script already completes all 12 qualified seeds when given this solver. Assisted success tests use of the available tool and workflow, not autonomous algorithm invention. Perfect public-pilot results do not establish general saturation; failures do not establish population discrimination.
reservation_scope: Not generated, solved, tuned or sent to models in this pilot. These are parameter holdouts within the same sampler, not independent task families or guarantees of hardness/solvability within the reference budget. Their future evaluation requires a separate frozen plan.
